comparison.objective: Release a hard drive from spring-loaded carrier rails and place it on an antistatic mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a rail deflected while lifting and sliding the drive off retaining pins without shock.
comparison.success_condition: Drive removed, placed flat and released on the mat; rail breakage or drive drop/knock irreversibly fails.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant restraint release and protected component extraction, not mandrel-guided hammer fracture or containment of generated debris.
